En verano el calor es excesivo por el calor que despiden las heladeras, debe contar con aire acondicionado.

Spectacular service and high-quality YPF FULL products.
They need to install self-closing mechanisms on the entrance doors because they remain open and the space gets cold. It's extremely uncomfortable to eat and enjoy the place. In summer, the heat from the refrigerators is excessive; they should have air conditioning.
